metaAudit.rationale: This independent evaluation inspected the narration/SRT, burned captions, project page, product and workflow interfaces, technical-report screenshots, sample-motion windows, presenter/referent relation, non-speech audio limitation, edited chronology versus dependency order, opening-to-closing escalation, negative-evidence scope, and technical-shot versus semantic-scene mismatch. The two omitted project-page facts and the title transcription error were caught by the GATE comparison, so they are not unguarded evaluation blind spots.
